content: Web consensus (Encore, dev.to, 2026): NestJS (12.x) enforces module boundaries with DI and is the usual pick for modular monoliths with many endpoints; Fastify (5.x) gives schema validation and a plugin/encapsulation system without classes; Hono (4.x) is unopinionated and suits small/edge services. Boundary discipline must be enforced by convention/lint in Fastify/Hono.
